answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 25728 Country: India Title: If Govt.(India) plans a scheme for investment that pay some money 6000 to 70000 per year and get a return six times after age 60 and some part in pension. Can we invest in such type of scheme ? Question: Assalamu alaikum, If Govt.(India) plans a scheme for investment that pay some money 6000 to 70000 per year and get a return six times after age 60 and some part in pension. Can we invest in such type of scheme . Answer ID: 25728 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2091/H=617/th=1431) This scheme is interest based; hence, it is haram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
